Chapter 7059: Heaven’S Demise

Chapter 7059: Heaven’s Demise

Revival was impossible and doubly so for immortals, not to mention those slain by the high heaven. In this case, there were thousands of overlords and immortals.

“I just can’t see how this is possible.” A spectator couldn’t fathom the mass revival.

Heaven’s Equal was aware of revival methods. Some were less pricey than others depending on the circumstances. This particular case had the worst odds.

“Interesting.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I’m afraid today is your last, what you face is beyond your...” Zhao Dachui laughed.

“Don’t be a frog under the well or assume others are also frogs.” Li Qiye interrupted: “This is just using the high heaven’s power for revival within this ocean. You all have imbued your intents into it and channeled the dao through it. This is still within the high heaven’s model and it is permitting you to do so, mere prisoners.”

“...” Zhao Dachui couldn’t respond.

“The villainous heaven has nothing I don’t know about.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Borrowing the high heaven’s power to live in the tribulation ocean? Does this count as revival?” Spectators exchanged glances.

“But why is there permission?” Another immortal asked.

“I’m curious, who is bringing life here for all of you?” Li Qiye asked.

“Hahaha, who else but the high heaven!” Zhao Dachui laughed, shocking the crowd with the comment.

After all, the revived horde had tried to kill the enforcer. Both sides were mortal enemies since the start of time. Moreover, why would the high heaven grant life after killing them?

“If the high heaven had wanted to give life, it wouldn’t be in this crude manner. You all are mere puppets, not living beings. There is no intelligence to be found.” Li Qiye said.

“Believe what you will.” Zhao Dachui said: “We are alive and well, this is the truth. The villainous heaven doesn’t have to work with just one party, you know this.”

“Is it true? Working with the high heaven?” A listener became puzzled. As far as they could tell, immortals and the high heaven were always enemies.

“You think too highly of yourself, working with the high heaven?” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Only you can work with it?” Zhao Dachui turned red.

“Who knows? I just know the villainous heaven won’t work with nobodies that have been defeated.” Li Qiye said.

“Haha, fine, you have a sharp tongue. It won’t help you survive today.” Zhao Dachui said.

“I don’t see anything here that is qualified to stop me.” Li Qiye said.

“Let us see then, if you have reached the legendary realm.” Zhao Dachui said.

“That depends on your ability.” Li Qiye said.

“Brothers, shall we begin?!” Zhao Dachui shouted.

“Boom!” Waves of lightning and flames surged again, forming three colossal figures.

Their celestial auras spread beyond Ruin, reaching all of Heavenrealm.

“Celestial immortals, so many...” Spectators were horrified.

The first had a sealing power, seemingly capable of stopping the high heaven’s power despite standing among the tribulations. Thus, being in his presence was suffocating. Only the strong-willed immortals could remain standing.

“Heaven’s Demise!” A golden immortal recognized him.

“Heaven Essence Alliance... they should have two celestial immortals.” A crowd member commented.
